A1.justification: Both PDFs describe CoCoDiff and contain 23 readable pages, including Appendices A-G. Text extraction and rendered-page inspection support comparison of the complete text, equations, tables, and figures.

before.justification: Section 4 reports original benchmark experiments, ablations, and a 25-participant user study. Appendices E-F contain further quantitative and visual results.

after.justification: The same original experiments, ablations, user study, and supplementary quantitative and visual results remain in Section 4 and Appendices E-F.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same correspondence matching, attention injection, cyclic refinement, stopping conditions, and AdaIN components.

E1.justification: Both retain MS-COCO content images, WikiArt styles, the same artistic-style coverage and user-study population, and the supplementary flower, cow, and house examples.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the main quantitative comparison, user study, and supplementary comparisons, including the patch-based methods in Appendix E/Table 6.

E3.justification: Section 4 retains the same image sample counts, four evaluation metrics, 50 DDIM steps, diffusion-model configurations, and user-study design. Appendix D reports identical experimental settings.

E4.justification: The backbone comparison, direct-versus-indirect correspondence analysis, adaptive-iteration study, Sobel/Gram and injection-weight/AdaIN ablations, and supplementary visual cases are unchanged.

E5.justification: Metric and preference reporting are unchanged. Neither version introduces different seed information, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or statistical tests.

E6.justification: Tables 1-6 and the qualitative results match. For example, Table 1 retains CoCoDiff's FID 18.432, LPIPS 0.549, ArtFID 30.100, and CFSD 0.609; Figure 5's plotted results are also unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations (1)-(16), correspondence selection, loss definitions, and mathematical material in Appendices C-D are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets, and conclusion retain the same claims about training-free fine-grained style transfer, semantic correspondence, cyclic refinement, and performance relative to prior methods.

C2.justification: Interpretations of correspondence quality, adaptive iteration, component tradeoffs, and SDXL alignment limitations remain unchanged. No substantive limitations or applicability qualifications are added.

D1.justification: Hardware, software versions, feature-injection timing, hyperparameters, dataset instructions, and code-access disclosures are unchanged. The added title-page email is an author-contact edit.

R1.justification: Section 2, the bibliography, and discussions positioning CoCoDiff against diffusion-based and patch-based approaches are unchanged; no cited works are added or removed.

P1.justification: v2 adds an author email beneath the affiliations and corrects missing spaces after punctuation in Section 4.4. The wording and section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The added email shifts the first-page text and moves one introduction line onto page 2. Figure 5 and its surrounding text receive a small layout adjustment. Figure/table content and all appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 adds contact information and makes small spacing and layout corrections, while preserving all scientific content, results, and reproducibility information, including the appendices. These cosmetic edits do not materially change the paper's overall quality.
